Jaguar Land Rover Recalls Over 250,000 SUVs in US

Jaguar Land Rover (JLR) has initiated a significant recall of over 250,000 luxury SUVs in the United States. The recall is due to a reported airbag defect affecting these vehicles. This action aims to address the safety concern associated with the defect in a large number of JLR vehicles.
